description: The closed vocabulary a design reference may speak in. A reference is evidence, not a template: what survives capture is a trait from this list, never markup, copy, an image or a stylesheet. Every trait names the axis it steers and the direction registry, art-direction compiler or design control that reads it. A trait with `consumer: null` is still recorded — a person is allowed to dislike something the factory cannot act on — but it says so rather than pretending to have changed a build.
rules: `useFor` is the part of the design a trait belongs to, and is what the Console asks a person to choose between. It never widens what a trait may change.

`adopt.prefer` is a partial map of axis to value. On selection it ranks the directions that already carry that value; on the four art-direction dimensions and on density it also overrides the registry's declared intent before compileArtDirectionPlan runs, so restraintLevel still clamps it.
`avoid.refuse` is a partial map of axis to the values a reference forbids. A direction carrying a refused value is refused with a recorded reason rather than generated and rejected later.

Composition axes (heroStrategy, gridFamily, headingTreatment, ctaPlacement, distinctiveMoment) and responsive axes participate in selection only. A reference chooses between directions and tunes the plan; it does not invent a direction, because a direction's structure is what makes candidates comparable.
Opposites are listed in pairs so a person can express either side. `avoid X` and `adopt not-X` are different statements: the first refuses a direction, the second steers towards one.

oversized-display-type.label: Oversized display typography
oversized-display-type.describe: The opening is sized like the point of the page.

restrained-display-type.label: Restrained display typography
restrained-display-type.describe: The opening behaves like any other section.

generous-whitespace.label: Generous whitespace
generous-whitespace.describe: Sections stand a long way apart and nothing is crowded.

dense-information.label: Dense information
dense-information.describe: A surface worked in rather than read, with no decoration that costs vertical space.

narrow-reading-measure.label: Narrow reading measure
narrow-reading-measure.describe: Text is set in a column narrow enough to read like a document.

wide-canvas.label: Wide canvas
wide-canvas.describe: The page uses the whole width of a large screen.

asymmetric-composition.label: Asymmetric composition
asymmetric-composition.describe: Items are laid out on an uneven grid rather than in equal columns.

symmetric-grid.label: Symmetric grid
symmetric-grid.describe: A regular grid of equal columns.

indexed-rows.label: Indexed editorial rows
indexed-rows.describe: A set of items reads as numbered rows rather than as cards.

imagery-led-opening.label: Imagery-led opening
imagery-led-opening.describe: A photograph carries the opening rather than the words about it.

typographic-opening.label: Typographic opening
typographic-opening.describe: The opening is a statement set in type, with no picture beside it.

split-opening.label: Split opening
split-opening.describe: The opening puts the claim beside the supporting material.

expressive-motion.label: Expressive motion
expressive-motion.describe: The page moves as it is read, and the movement is part of the effect.

restrained-motion.label: Restrained motion
restrained-motion.describe: Movement is feedback only. Nothing performs.

alternating-section-ground.label: Alternating section ground
alternating-section-ground.describe: The page changes ground as it scrolls so a long read is broken into passages.

single-ground.label: One ground throughout
single-ground.describe: Every section sits on the same ground.

ruled-section-headings.label: Ruled section headings
ruled-section-headings.describe: A rule sits above each section heading.

plain-section-headings.label: Plain section headings
plain-section-headings.describe: Section headings carry no rule or ornament.

mobile-simplification.label: Simplified on a phone
mobile-simplification.describe: The phone rendering is tightened and reordered rather than being the desktop one with fewer columns.

disclosure-navigation.label: Disclosure navigation
disclosure-navigation.describe: Navigation collapses behind a control on a small screen.

inline-navigation.label: Inline navigation
inline-navigation.describe: Navigation stays visible and scrolls sideways on a small screen.

dark-ground.label: Dark full-page ground
dark-ground.describe: The page is composed on a dark ground.
dark-ground.unconsumedReason: Every visual direction the factory offers composes on the light ground the design system compiles, and the accent comes from the company's own material rather than from a reference. Recording this preference is honest; claiming it changed a build would not be.

light-ground.label: Light ground
light-ground.describe: The page is composed on a light ground.
light-ground.unconsumedReason: The factory already composes every direction on a light ground, so this preference is already satisfied and changes nothing.

sticky-navigation.label: Sticky navigation
sticky-navigation.describe: Navigation stays fixed to the top of the viewport as the page scrolls.
sticky-navigation.unconsumedReason: The template's navigation treatment is a responsive decision between disclosure and inline scrolling; whether the header sticks is not a decision any current direction, plan or token expresses.

horizontal-ticker.label: Horizontal ticker
horizontal-ticker.describe: A band of content moves sideways on its own.
horizontal-ticker.unconsumedReason: No presentation in the registry scrolls itself, so the factory could not produce one to avoid. Recorded so a reviewer can see the preference was heard.
